sigma_diff.data_reference: secomb2020mass; tissue O2 diffusivity, as tissue_diffusion_face

Lx.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; 100 um cube: 5 x 5 x 5 cells of 20 um, the tissue_diffusion_volume default cell (V_P 8e-15 m3)

grid_nx.data_reference: definitional; exchange-region grid (one cell per connected 0D module) and, with fv_scheme 1, the finite-volume grid

refine.data_reference: definitional; finite-element cells per grid cell and direction (fv_scheme 0)

fv_scheme.data_reference: definitional; 0 = Q1 finite elements, 1 = two-point-flux finite volumes on the grid

M.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; maximal O2 consumption, as tissue_diffusion_volume (M0 = 7.5 cm3 O2/100 cm3/min = 0.0558 mM/s, negative: consumption)

C50.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; Michaelis constant P0 = 10.5 mmHg x 1.27 uM/mmHg (fang2008oxygen), as tissue_diffusion_volume

C_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; 47 mmHg mean cortical tissue PO2 (celayaalcala2021simulation) x 1.27 uM/mmHg (fang2008oxygen), as tissue_diffusion_volume

coupling_dt.data_reference: definitional; coupling step with the 0D model (tissue O2 changes over seconds)
